scenario: The same decision context evaluated by a plain deterministic implementation and by a policy-engine-backed implementation produces the same semantic decision; no engine is privileged in conformance.

providers.implementation: policy-engine bundle evaluating the same policy version

when: both providers decide the same context at the same policy version

reasons: both return the same outcome (ask — independent human approver required)
both cite the same policy identity and version in explain
both name the same missing obligation and remediation
must_not: differ in outcome, obligations, or exception applicability between engines
require the caller to know which implementation served the decision
treat the engine-backed result as more authoritative than the plain rules
